$comment: Stage spec: enumeration — CONTENT enumeration of services mapped by EAS (JS/API extraction, directory/path, parameter discovery). 阶段重排 2026-06-09: 端口/服务前移到 EAS; 本阶段在已知服务上挖内容, 产出可测单元 = vuln_triage 分母. 见 docs/design/2026-06-09-active-stage-verify-first.md.
$comment_findings_allowed: Content-enumeration stage: the deliverable is js/api/dir/param coverage (testable units feeding vuln_triage), NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.
$comment_host_aware: Host-aware coverage 2b + 2026-07-01 IP-web: content enumeration (JS/DIR/PARAM/JSAPI) is web-level. Domain/URL assets are always content-enumeration targets; bare IP/CIDR targets are included only when EAS/httpx proved HTTP service via targets.http_status (enum_ip_web_coverage). Unknown class keeps all 4 (fail-safe).
$comment_freshness_window: Phase E activation (design 2026-06-22 Phase D): gray-switch ON. The ENUM DB-truth back-fill (GOLISH-ENUM-DIR/PARAM/JSAPI) only counts content discovered this stage-run (directory_entries.created_at + api_endpoints.discovered_at >= stage start). enumeration coverage_complete is derive_from_evidence (NOT authoritative), so this makes the DB auto-fill fresh-only; self-reported cells still fall back. Default false = presence-only.

hints: add evidence to each claim via prior tool calls
add evidence to each finding via prior tool calls

gate_rules.$comment_derive: Phase 1 (2026-06-12-redteam-phase1) + 2026-06-26 enumeration deliverables/flow + 2026-06-29 internal DIR probe: DB business-table truth 补格 — GOLISH-ENUM-DIR←directory_entries(route_probe_paths), -PARAM←api_endpoints.params(browser/js_extract/crawler observed params), -JSAPI←api_endpoints.source IN (js_analysis,crawler). 真跑工具落库后 coverage 格自动补 found; 不开 authoritative (DIR/PARAM Empty 事实源未就绪), 自报 checked_empty/blocked/not_applicable 仍兜底.

on_fail.reason: content enumeration incomplete: some alive in-scope services were not fully enumerated (js/api / dir / param)
hints: for EVERY EAS-confirmed live web root, take GOLISH-ENUM-JSAPI (browser_collect_js_api -> js_extract_apis), GOLISH-ENUM-DIR (route_probe_paths once after JS/API landing with target_id + base_url, DB seeds, and its recursive local/built-in wordlist queue), and GOLISH-ENUM-PARAM (observed request/query/form parameters plus targeted js_extract_apis param_hints) to a terminal state

do NOT hand-write found cells already backed by DB truth; found is projected from directory_entries/api_endpoints after real tools land rows with target_id. Use submitted coverage only for checked_empty+evidence, blocked+note, or not_applicable+note states the DB cannot derive yet

$comment_expected_techniques: 枚举阶段内容技术（GOLISH-ENUM-*，登记于 technique_taxonomy.json）。阶段重排 2026-06-09：端口/服务已在 EAS 做，本阶段只挖内容。coverage_complete 对每个存活服务逐类核终态；产出可测单元是 vuln_triage total_units 分母来源。
$comment_stage_run: stage_run fan-out (design 2026-06-13-stage-run-fanout §3.2): specialist = the per-org sub-agent stage_run fans out (enumeration → enumerator, the ACTIVE content-enumeration specialist split from Pentester, mirroring prober for EAS); coverage_axis = the human-readable technique columns StageRunView renders per org row (one per expected technique: js / dir / param / jsapi).
$comment_min_invocations: 2026-06-26 enumeration deliverables/flow: no hard tool floor. HTTP probing and service fingerprinting belong to external_attack_surface; enumeration completeness is DIR/PARAM/JSAPI DB truth plus explicit non-found terminal coverage.
